name: Chamber of Commerce Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Chamber of Commerce Liaison Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Wednesday, May 22, 2024
  1:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  May 22, 2024 / 1:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis, Beverly
  Hills Chamber of Commerce Director of Economic Development &
  Government Affairs Brittany Ganson

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Miami Feasibility Report Presentation for Mission:
  a. Presentation from Brittany Ganson:
  i. The chamber has been interested in a business mission to Miami-Dade
  County since around 2016.
  ii. The chamber has partnered with Kevin Griner at Urban Centric Analytics
  to determine the feasibility of such a trip.
  iii. Miami’s economy is growing rapidly and is outperforming every county with
  over 1 million people with the exception of two in Texas.
  iv. Investors from Miami will have an easy time adjusting to the economic
  situation of Beverly Hills and Los Angeles due to the economic similarities
  of the two areas These include having large international populations,
  being tourism and lifestyle centers, and being international financial
  gateways.
  v. Miami has been improving the quality of its hospitality businesses over the
  past several years.
  vi. Miami has developed a reputation for its architecture, particularly for its
  parking garages.
  vii. Both Urban Centric Analytics and the Chamber view Miami as a strong
  target for a business mission.
  viii. Key things to make the mission successful are:
  1. Committing to creating a long-term highly visible presence in South
  Florida targeting social media accounts, businesses, and
  entrepreneurs.
  2. Telling the Beverly Hills Story: getting Beverly Hills into the minds
  of businesses and investors.
 Highlights for May 22, 2024
Chamber of Commerce Liaison Committee

  3. ID growing businesses and South Florida’s most creative
  developers in the hospitality, restaurant, financial, and tech sectors.
  4. Recruit local businesses leaders as BH ambassadors.
  5. Hold visits with key organizations and leaders.
  ix. The Chamber recommends 2 days of meetings with a primary focus on
  business attraction, with a goal if 12 new business meetings across 2
  tracks.
  x. The Mayor and Vice Mayor will attend the trip.
  b.  The growth of finance and tech in Miami is mostly from domestic labor force
  development, not from California or Northeast migrants.
  c.  Miami has a sizeable internation investor community who the city could effectively
  target.
  d.  Both Liaisons are in favor of conducting further research for a Miami trip with a
  focus on scope and scale.
  e.  Mayor Friedman also recommends looking into the possibility of a third day for the
  trip.

  3) Future Agenda Items:
  a. The Chamber’s FY 2024-25 workplan will be discussed in the next couple of
  weeks.

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: May 22, 2024 / 1:38 PM
